summary: Toronto, Canada, post-doctoral researcher in cognitive neuroscience, strong interest in meta cognition and consciousness research, pro-union, engaged in play-by-post tabletop role-playing games (Pathfinder), critical of corporate practices and data privacy issues, advocates for basic income and economic reform, family-oriented, values community and local governance, skeptical of mainstream economic theories, interested in the intersection of technology and privacy, supports open-source software, and has a nuanced view on political and social issues.
